Your turn sounds good.

The piano starts its melody after the logo opens. If your browser needs a first tap, choose Enable sound.

Tap any piano key to take over. Your sounds and notes appear together. Hold a few keys for a chord.

After you stop playing for 15 seconds, the melody gently picks up where it paused. Use Pause whenever you want quiet.

The little piano lights matching note names across the song’s octaves. The staff follows the actual pitches. It’s a place to explore, with a simplified pitch guide.

Behind the music.

Victor’s Piano Solo from Corpse Bride, composed by Danny Elfman. This is the simplified, transposed music-box arrangement by SinfoniaItaliana used in the piano lab.
